answer: In the Data For Good generative AI white paper, BLOOM's estimated training carbon footprint changed from an initial calculation of approximately 39.3 tonnes CO2eq to an extended full-scope estimate of 50.5 tonnes CO2eq. This increase was due to the inclusion of the impact of server manufacturing and the development phase of the model, which added an additional 73.32 tonnes CO2eq. Thus, the total impact of the model, including the development phase, was calculated to be 123.82 tonnes CO2eq.
